meta.title: 2:00 AM — The scream
meta.tagline: A scream in the dark. Real… or just for you?

strings.it.intro.title: 2:00 AM — The scream
strings.it.intro.body:
It is 2 in the morning.

A scream cuts through the silence, brief… then suddenly stopped.
You stay perfectly still. You do not know if it is real. You do not know where it came from.

But you know one thing: it will happen again.
strings.it.s1.title: The hallway
strings.it.s1.body:
The floorboards creak under your weight.
The hallway light flickers once… then steadies.

The air is cold. Not like an open window.
Like a room that has been sealed for years.

At the far end, the darkness seems thicker.
strings.it.s1.c2: Turn off the light and listen, following your instinct
strings.it.s1.c3: Whisper: "Is someone there?" and follow the sound
strings.it.s2.title: The stairs
strings.it.s2.body:
You go down slowly.
Halfway down, you see a door left slightly open.
Behind it, a draft smells of damp stone.

Your phone says 02:00.
You have no signal.

And then… a second scream.
Closer.
Lower.
As if it came from inside the house.
strings.it.s2.c1: Follow the hallway toward the scream
strings.it.s2.c2: Place your hand on the wall to guide yourself and follow it
strings.it.s3.title: The marked door
strings.it.s3.body:
There is a symbol carved into the door, barely visible.
The handle is freezing cold.

Inside the lock, something glints: a metal fragment, a rusty key jammed there for a long time.

You want to grab it.
But your fingers are shaking.
And the scream turns into breathing, right behind the wood.

You cannot continue without unlocking the missing item. This scene is here to show you the token system.
strings.it.s3.c3: Try to open it by banging on it
strings.it.s4.title: On the other side
strings.it.s4.body:
The lock gives way with a sharp crack.
The breathing stops.

The room is empty.
Just a chair.
And on the floor, a damp trail, as if someone had crawled there.
strings.it.s4.c1: Leave the building and call for help
strings.it.s4.c2: Step back slowly, without making a sound
strings.it.end_good.title: Well done — you made it out
strings.it.end_good.body:
Silence falls again.
You breathe.

strings.it.end_bad.title: Ending — you ran away
strings.it.end_bad.body:
You step back suddenly and run.

Behind you, the scream starts again… but this time, it seems to be following you.
